versions.name: Camp Bartlett

features.note: A fire bowl overlooking the lake.
An archery range with eight shooting lanes.
A centralised shower house with individual showers and dressing rooms.
A forty-five-foot climbing wall with three routes.
Three cooked meals a day, with a bring-your-own-food option.
A rifle range with sixteen lanes, using smallbore rifles.
Lake Fife, with docks and changing booths.

versions.summary: Crossroads of the West Council's resident camp in Idaho's Bear Lake Valley near Montpelier, featuring 50+ campsites around a stocked lake, with swimming, paddling, range sports, climbing, and slacklining.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
